title: Don't download.
body: It will make you take a quiz, submit your email address and only then inform that you only have 5 days of free trial. Scam to steal data.
author: Veiacava

title: Línguas
body: Podia ser possível escolher o idioma ou pelo menos silêncio o texto para o utilizador poder copiar e traduzir
author: traduzam

title: Registration process shows creators know nothing about ADHD
body: The app requires an account to work, and the only way of creating an account is to start with a free trial that is automatically renewed for ca. €230 per year or ca. €50 per month. Everybody who had only the slightest awareness of what ADHD is, knows that it’s very likely that users will forget to cancel the automatic renewal. This setup basically takes away all confidence I may have in an ADHD companion app, and suggests that it’s just another money making scheme.
author: Meikitsu
